newsitem.title: FRANCE: Lafarge H1 net profit halves to 545 mln Fr.
newsitem.headline: Lafarge H1 net profit halves to 545 mln Fr.

text.p: (Figures in millions of French francs unless stated)

NOTE - French building materials company Lafarge gave its results in a statement. It said net attributable profit fell 53 percent due to the drop in pre-exceptional, operating profit and the virtual absence of exceptional items. It made exceptional gains of 47 million francs in the period compared to 429 million a year ago. Operating profit fell 26 percent due to a continued depression in European markets in the first quarter and severe winter weather.
Given the seasonal nature of many of the company's businesses, the first half results should not be considered representative for the full year, it said.

Shareholders equity stood at 31,572 million francs at the end of June, compared to 30,794 million at the end of 1995. Net debt stood at 4,369 million francs compared to 2,938 million at December 31, 1995.
